archive.catalogue_description: Description Nazi Zombie SPECIAL COMBAT 1.1 This mod will change CODWaW zombie mode with high quality retextured modern weapons from Way2Evil modern weapons mod and other new custom features. You can also play the great ZCT Mod 2 included in the download package. Current version: 1.1 Compatibility: all Prototype Style Maps -Main features: – Special weapons: – Usp Laser – Raythrower – Nuke Launcher – M60 High Explosive Incendiary ammo – High quality retextured weapons – Enhanced weapons fx effects – Laser pointer – Slightly increased rocket and granade launcher explosion&range damages for more realism – Overall balanced weapons damage, increased knife damage (only for last stand weapons, see chart below) – ZCT Mod 2 support -Weapons Chart: -TIPS! – With m60heis shot at feet! but not yours.. – Pay attention to your rocket explosions! – Do not overheat USP laser… – Special Combat knife will save your life!! – Cabinets seem now more interesting… : ) -Recommended compatible maps: Custom maps: airport castle chatedral CB fun park nazi zombie 420 panic center zct castle zm mars zombie rich Prototype maps: anzio axfactory dv (dead valley) fruchurch frumansion gefangnis island labo lost prototype (natch der untoten) rage shore station streets subway the river tun (tunnels) village2 Installation Instructions (ZM installer exe): —Make sure you have updated the game to 1.7 patch— 1- Install the mod. 2- Go to mods folder: (XP)C:/Documents and Settings/YOUR_PROFILE/Local Settings/Applicatio

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3).
